title: Remember Hussain
body:
O Hussain, you Live forever be in our hearts and in our minds x2
I swear to Allah until my last breath I will remember Hussain
O Hussain, You Live forever be in our hearts and in our mind
I  swear to Allah you have shown us so much courage through the pain
You sacrified your family and were killed thirsty O Hussain
You gave everything for Allah, never did you complain
I swear to Allah until my last breath I will remember Hussain
O Hussain, you Live forever be in our hearts and in our minds x2
I swear to Allah until my last breath I will remember Hussain
O Hussain, You Live forever be in our hearts and in our minds
I swear to Allah whenever I face trouble in my life
I close my eyes and see your shrine and call Labaik, Everytime
O Hussain your are the love of my heart you are light of my eyes
I swear to Allah until my last breath
I will remember Hussain
